handwritten.source: Written by an AI agent (Claude) that never saw the detector's code, modeled on scam patterns described in public advisories. Sources: eval/SOURCES.md.

notes: Held-out test split; scoring weights may be tuned only on the dev split.
All cases are fictional. Synthetic and hand-written data likely overestimate real-world accuracy.

Re-run after fixing a bug the first test run exposed: two different unregistered domains in one message were counted as two signals. First test run (before the fix): precision 79.2%, recall 100%, F1 88.4% on the same 42 cases.
Some fictional legitimate messages use made-up sender domains. The live lookup correctly reports them as unregistered, which can produce false positives that a real company's domain would not.
